quarterly_data.quarter: NetApp press release: NetApp Removes Storage Bottleneck for AI Factories (09-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: NetApp announced NetApp Novus, which it calls 'the fastest storage on the planet' (company claim), designed for AI infrastructure providers operating large GPU environments (neoclouds and GPU-as-a-Service providers). The initial Novus release combines NetApp Novus Data Director, the metadata software, running on qualified Supermicro infrastructure with NetApp ONTAP data services delivered through AFF A90 systems; the disaggregated architecture separates metadata from the data path under a single namespace using industry-standard NFS, is 'built to exceed throughput of 100TB per second and support high utilization of hundreds of thousands of GPUs', 'is orderable today', and provides a path to software-defined deployments over time. Chief Product Officer Syam Nair: 'Novus delivers 100 TB/s of unlimited scale-out performance' and 'We’ve just delivered the fastest storage on the planet'.
quarterly_data.figure: architected for up to 100 TB per second aggregate throughput; hundreds of thousands of GPUs; orderable today
